content.short: Relay is an online business banking platform for US and Canadian SMBs with multiple accounts and cards.
content.description: Relay is an online business banking and money-management platform for small and medium businesses across the US and Canada, designed around cash-flow clarity. It lets owners open multiple checking accounts and issue up to dozens of physical and virtual debit cards, making it easy to organize money using methods like Profit First and separate funds for taxes, payroll and expenses, while giving team members controlled access. Relay also supports ACH and wire payments, bill pay through an integrated accounts-payable workflow, and connections to accounting tools like QuickBooks and Xero. By focusing on multiple accounts, cards and collaborative access rather than a single balance, it helps owners and bookkeepers see exactly where money goes.
